summary: Lightspeed Commerce Inc. filed a Form 6-K to announce the date and details of its fiscal first quarter 2027 earnings conference call. The company will report results before market open on July 30, 2026, and host a conference call at 8:00 am ET, with a replay available through August 6, 2026. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation. The filing includes no M&A, tender, restructuring, or other transformative event. It is a standard foreign private issuer report providing operational and financial communication to shareholders and the market.
